requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles capable of delivering 6,000 pages for both black and CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports high page yield and efficiency for customers, addressing market demand for higher capacity consumables.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with NOA-F, IDS, and existing ink systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must pass page yield testing with at least 6,000 pages for black and CMY, and CMY bottle size must support >8,000 pages under ISO standards.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure ink bottles and bottle-to-tank interface are designed for spill-free operation during user installation and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces mess and improves user experience, key for customer satisfaction and warranty claims reduction.
requirements.Dependencies: Linked to bottle design, NOA-F interface, and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spills during 100 consecutive bottle replacements in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Implement NOA-F (New On-demand Air-Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth design and a lid label, maintaining current push-push and TDF features.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances air management, reliability, and product differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, IDS, printer assembly process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F must pass air flow and reliability tests, and be compatible with existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Leverage existing SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation for the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces R&D cost and time to market by reusing proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new bottle and tank systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks perform to existing specifications in Magellan units.

requirements.Title: Reliability and IDS Characterization & Modeling
requirements.Description: Model and characterize system reliability, including Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR), air gain, flow rate, IDS (Ink Delivery System) performance, startup, and NOA-F End of Life (EOL).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust system design and high product reliability throughout lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires finalized IDS and NOA-F design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Completion of reliability and IDS models, with all parameters within defined engineering tolerances.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess impact on print quality (PQ) over time.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents degradation of print quality and supports warranty claims.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on ink formulation and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink remains stable for the duration of warranty period, with no PQ defects observed in accelerated aging tests.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as service parts for warranty support, ensuring availability during the warranty period.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and supports contractual service obligations.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F design finalization and supply chain planning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts are available for all warranty claims within service SLAs.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (likely a tracking or authentication feature) onto the lid of the bottle or tank system.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances traceability, anti-counterfeit, and quality assurance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 feature is present and functional on all production lids, passing security validation.

requirements.Title: Modify Existing SA 14 Line for NOA-F
requirements.Description: Update the existing SA 14 factory line to support assembly and testing of NOA-F components.
requirements.Rationale: Enables efficient manufacturing and quality control for new components.
requirements.Dependencies: Final NOA-F design, factory retooling schedule.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA 14 line is operational for NOA-F production, meeting yield and quality targets.

requirements.Title: Add Magi Ink Cart and Labelling Tool in Orcus 5
requirements.Description: Install Magi ink cartridge assembly and labelling tools in Orcus 5 production line.
requirements.Rationale: Supports production of new ink system and traceability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magi ink cart and labelling tool are installed and validated in Orcus 5 line.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F to be customer-replaceable, minimizing service intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and increases customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires robust design for user handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F with no tools and minimal instructions, with <2% error rate in pilot tests.

requirements.Title: Support New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure system reliability and consumable capacity to support a warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive differentiation and reduced total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: All system components must meet durability targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes accelerated life testing to 80,000 pages with no critical failures.

requirements.Title: Product Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington industrial design (ID) with modifications for increased tank size; maintain Marconi-HI ADF and EPS foam packaging.
requirements.Rationale: Accommodates higher capacity while leveraging existing design elements.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and chassis design, packaging updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes design review and packaging tests with new tank size and EPS foam.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure product compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental standards for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Enables sales in regulated markets and supports sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product achieves certifications for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize overall size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures physical compatibility and maintains compact product footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays operate without interference, and overall product dimensions meet target specifications.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphical display (CGD) for user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Improves usability and aligns with market expectations for modern printers.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Product Management, UX Design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is functional and passes user experience testing.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Tube Routing
requirements.Description: Utilize Sayan Sibstar tubes and implement new tube routing and integration for the ink delivery system.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and supports new tank configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tubes are installed without leaks or flow issues in 100 test units.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management with Tank Changes
requirements.Description: Update service station for aerosol management, accounting for changes due to new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and ensures long-term reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within safe limits in endurance testing.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with New Tubes and Weights
requirements.Description: Develop new dynamic and force models for the carriage, accounting for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures print quality and mechanical reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force and acceleration limits in simulation and physical testing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path to support increased duty cycle and page life up to 80k pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent reliability and performance over extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components pass 80k page accelerated life test.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable at service centers after 80k page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates extended product life and supports service contracts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance parts in <30 minutes with standard tools.

requirements.Title: 140ml Black and New CMY Bottles
requirements.Description: Introduce 140ml black bottles and new capacity CMY bottles for Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Supports higher page yields and reduces refill frequency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles meet capacity and compatibility requirements in production units.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection for the Ink Delivery System (IDS).
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and serviceability of ink connections.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Connections pass leak and durability tests over 5,000 cycles.

requirements.Title: Leverage LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size and Keying
requirements.Description: Adopt LEBI ink-tank design with increased size, unique keying, and LOI (Level of Integration) One SHAID for security and compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents cross-contamination and supports secure supply chain.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and bottle design, SHAID technology.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No incorrect bottle insertions in 100 user tests; SHAID passes security audit.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system to support new tank and ink delivery configuration.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable startup and prevents airlocks in the ink system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm enables successful priming and no airlocks in 100 consecutive startups.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithm for Magellan platform, optimizing for reliability and user experience.
requirements.Rationale: Improves system uptime and reduces service calls.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithm passes field validation with <2% service call rate due to startup issues.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion definitions to align with updated page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output and clear customer communication on ink usage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals are met in 95% of test prints; depletion alerts align with actual ink usage in 90% of cases.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for electronics and power supply.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages proven, reliable components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components pass integration and system validation tests in Magellan units.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for wireless connectivity and system control.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern connectivity requirements and up-to-date firmware platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi and firmware features pass functional and security testing.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compliance with security standards and protects against threats.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes internal and external security audits to Gauss4.xx standard.

requirements.Title: Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise Segments
requirements.Description: Ensure the product line and services are tailored to the needs of consumer, SMB, and enterprise segments, including PaaS (Printing as a Service) and flexible onboarding paths.
requirements.Rationale: Expands market reach and supports diverse customer requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product SKUs and onboarding paths are available and validated for all segments.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution and Enterprise Support (WJA, HPSM, JAM)
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution and enterprise support tools (Web JetAdmin, HP Smart Management, JAM) for manageability.
requirements.Rationale: Essential for SMB and enterprise customers requiring fleet management and advanced features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan and enterprise management features are functional and validated in enterprise deployments.

requirements.Title: Support for Multiple Clients and Drivers
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers for broad compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures seamless integration in diverse IT environments and simplifies deployment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Drivers are available and pass compatibility testing on all supported platforms.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA achieves a minimum life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for product reliability and competitive positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes life testing to at least 65,000 pages without failure.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with customer expectations and competitive offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product supports warranty claims for 2 years or 80k pages without major issues.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 PPM (PDL: 25/19 PPM)
requirements.Description: Achieve print throughput of 25/20 pages per minute (PPM), with PDL SKUs reaching 25/19 PPM.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market performance benchmarks and customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified throughput in ISO test conditions.

requirements.Title: Serviceability of Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure maintenance box is easily serviceable for users or service technicians.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced in <10 minutes with no special tools.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK and Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Design flexibility to support host 12K-CMYK and trade page 6K configurations, subject to business priorities.
requirements.Rationale: Allows adaptation to changing market and business needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Configurations are validated and available as business needs arise.
